# Artur Castiel Reis de Souza

> Reservoir Simulation Scientist at TNO, Utrecht, Netherlands.

I develop numerical methods and open‑source simulators for flow in porous media, from multiscale finite volumes on unstructured grids to local grid refinement in OPM Flow.

My research covers non-orthodox flux approximations and multiscale finite volume methods, applied to hydrogen storage, carbon capture & storage and enhanced geothermal systems. I am also an active contributor to the Open Porous Media (OPM) initiative.
